runtime.command_template: python tools/frankenstein_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game frankst --rom-path <authorized-existing-rom-root> --work-dir <new-empty-state-directory> --scenario <raw_run.scenario_path> --dmd-dir <external-run-dmd> --output <external-run.json>. Keyboard handling off, mechanisms off, binary solenoid mode, default 2 s boot wait. Service screens are reached by stepping Black until the title band matches a verified template (tools/frankenstein_header_templates.json); the frame readings are pinned to pixel digests in tools/seeds/sega/mary-shelley-s-frankenstein-1995-runtime-readings.json (SHA256 3512a82db67e2b2d244be4adea11bb053e23622fbbd2d724dde5cd61656200bb), with the ROM members, library, adapter, template and harness digests.

coil-test.note: COIL TEST: the right flipper button shows the next entry with its name, power and control wire colours and number, and Start fires it. Each entry fired only its own public address; the R entries select relay 10 first and the L entries release it. Relay 10 has no entry of its own and #8R is printed FLASH:NOT USED. Raw scenario SHA256 e66a1a0ea01bbd5a30fabe2ef845a0bd836388a88ba1da0e892d9585745f082c; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 9ad96d84f4b60e4b84f5d4db7aace89d4f3ab53bfa0b68c10792c372e22545a7.

cycling.note: CYCLING FLASHERS pulses 25-32 behind relay 10 and 15; CYCLING COILS walks 1-9 with each muxed 25-32 behind relay 10, then 11-22. Boot pulses 13 once and toggles 37, 38 and 44. Raw scenario SHA256 8cf474eb7ed7ee3c9e9e3734d13bd54286f404e3e0bce3c3814a93a1c84085b7; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 d36b4893e63b0a823d2905d111620583531bde5c982e7436fcf1726899b5a5e7.

right-button: paired states asserted and released together

gameplay.note: Fresh six-ball trough; two coins and Start, then the host moves balls only after the ROM's own output. Same-run checkpoints: trough lockout, up-kicker, lever autolaunch, upper and lower scoops, North Pole VUK, Ice Cave eject, four bumpers, two slings, the left outlane Laser Kick and the spinner-fired right orbit diverter; both cabinet buttons assert and release their paired synthetic states. An unchecked tail of three ramp shots and VUK closures fired no trap door (9, 12) or creature output (13). Raw scenario SHA256 4cfe8436b23541f25a45ecda2ebd9c1262d20af43d2139f998513e6c7fa30936; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 b2df2f5ef662a2d834e7c9126774d9b480d37284489d9ec24c929328c79b8998.

lamp-test.note: SINGLE LAMP TEST: step 1 shows NONE, each later Start press lit exactly lamp n-1 with its name, drive and return wire colours, and step 66 wraps to lamp 1. Raw scenario SHA256 f19fe2faa2a37c452042a17841b71ba1413aab4cd611cb199fb9fcb20b45aae2; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 40a280cfafae2cc8d6a60e2f2458f99d901f93ea51dabc3a7b3d2029e39a7dc7.

servo-laser-kick.note: SERVO TEST: each Start press toggles the creature head routine; 44 rises and falls around each command while 37 and 38 toggle, and no other driver changes. LASER KICK TEST: the closed left outlane alone fires nothing (the test waits for a ball), while the VUK, eject, both scoops and the shooter lane each fire their own kicker. Raw scenario SHA256 df43c551331a565f2ab4c4a3bbf7bb862e843c29a8f263b78913f8e8edb39e88; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 e575961ed9a914efbdcc41e5d135bdef09e417426ce21715f6a09855efe0de08.

switch-test.note: ACTIVE SWITCH TEST: every public address 1-64 and 81-88 held 2.0 s, released 1.4 s. The green forward/reverse button (-6) is held throughout to make Black step forward. Each closed public address appears alone with its name, drive and return wire colours and number. Direct writes to 63/64 read back 0 and show NONE (the flipper column overwrites them); 82 and 84 read back as 64 and 63 and are named RIGHT and LEFT END OF STROKE; 81, 83 and 85-88 show NONE. Raw scenario SHA256 82cc610a6bdd40aff01a3d41f698ffd9c62b43963877db0b77728f50058ca3ca; canonical parsed repository scenario SHA256 f748708cd9415b4206231e9d9b60dd02ad127ad9e399447f40a28348fefcc368.
